name: jgm4-projects
description: JGM4 Projects — solicitações e alinhamento local

scripts.setup: npm run db:start && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/browser-check.ts && npm run test:browser:stage2 && npm run test:browser:stage3 && npm run test:browser:stage4 && npm run test:browser:stage5
